title: design-run
description: Fail-loud state for one design run. A gate exits ONLY via pass or overridden(reason); a halted gate blocks ship. No silent degradation.

brand_kit.description: path to the active brand-kit profile; required, never defaulted

references.description: exemplar reference screenshots/URLs fed to the builder + floor rubric. COUNTED, not documentation: `gate --name references --status pass` is refused below 3, and ship-check/done re-verify the count. Write via `run_state.py references --add`; local paths must exist.

base_sha.description: target-repo git HEAD at init; baseline for the drawing_check git-diff. null if the target is not a git repo

vendored.description: files/dirs written by component-library installs; drawing_check exempts these (sanctioned copy-paste svg/canvas, not hand-drawing)
